acceptance.oracle: Missing, stale or incomplete required telemetry is not zero activity.
acceptance.title: stale coverage

acceptance.oracle: Eligible observation interval boundaries and clock uncertainty are explicit.
acceptance.title: freshness windows

acceptance.oracle: Only selected cohorts revert; other accepted migrations remain intact.
acceptance.title: targeted rollback

acceptance.oracle: Recovery does not restore revoked authority or discard newer protected knowledge.
acceptance.title: security floor

acceptance.oracle: Changing an accepted plan invalidates dependent approvals and requires new assessment.
acceptance.title: plan revision

acceptance.oracle: Approval binds exact plan/action/target/cohort; any substitution refuses.
acceptance.title: exact approval

acceptance.oracle: Valid signatures from unrecognized parties do not satisfy approval.
acceptance.title: recognized principal

acceptance.oracle: One jurisdiction cannot mask another required missing or denying jurisdiction.
acceptance.title: joint jurisdiction

acceptance.oracle: Expired/not-yet-valid approval cannot advance a transition.
acceptance.title: temporal approval

acceptance.oracle: Submitted PASS reports must be recomputed or recognized under an explicit evidence rule.
acceptance.title: asserted PASS

acceptance.oracle: Missing/wrong provenance, observer or subject cannot satisfy an obligation.
acceptance.title: evidence provenance

acceptance.oracle: Duplicate signatures/keys do not increase threshold or independence.
acceptance.title: duplicate signer

acceptance.oracle: Applicable negative evidence remains visible and has declared precedence.
acceptance.title: contradictions

acceptance.oracle: Declared completeness is distinguished from actually qualified source coverage.
acceptance.title: coverage court

acceptance.oracle: Cutover checks source, destination and consumer consistency under declared scope.
acceptance.title: cutover court

acceptance.oracle: Decision replay binds model, policy, evidence, time and evaluator without issuing effects.
acceptance.title: replay court

acceptance.oracle: Court result alone never becomes effect authority or native admission.
acceptance.title: no self-authorization

acceptance.oracle: Preparing an effect changes no external target.
acceptance.title: prepare pure

acceptance.oracle: An input document or agent result cannot manufacture a host authorization.
acceptance.title: approval separate

acceptance.oracle: Relevant target/pre-state/expiry rechecked at effect point; lack of atomicity declared.
acceptance.title: commit precondition

acceptance.oracle: Duplicate idempotency key does not repeat an already confirmed effect in qualified adapter.
acceptance.title: duplicate request

acceptance.oracle: An effect whose response was lost is reconciled before retry.
acceptance.title: lost acknowledgement

acceptance.oracle: Partial target mutation is reported with uncertainty, not no-effect refusal.
acceptance.title: partial effect

acceptance.oracle: Restart at consequential journal boundaries restores the accepted projection.
acceptance.title: restart recovery

acceptance.oracle: Replaying a journal never reissues commands.
acceptance.title: replay non-effectful

acceptance.oracle: Overlapping migrations cannot overwrite selected plan/state without conflict handling.
acceptance.title: concurrent migration

acceptance.oracle: Retries stop at declared budget and preserve terminal/unknown outcomes.
acceptance.title: bounded retry

acceptance.oracle: Used, cancelled or superseded approval cannot be reused.
acceptance.title: approval consumption

acceptance.oracle: Different target/cohort/configuration after prepare refuses.
acceptance.title: scope substitution

acceptance.oracle: Compensation runs only its authorized scope and does not erase historical effects.
acceptance.title: compensation

acceptance.oracle: Unsupported adapters, hostile-host assumptions and physical durability remain explicit gates.
acceptance.title: host limits

requirements.requirement: Implement submit, compile, observe, assess, plan, prepare, approve, commit, verify, pause, resume, compensate, retire and replay with versioned state.
Use a durable event journal and recoverable projections; recorded observations, clocks and nondeterministic outcomes are explicit inputs.
Reconcile current observations with compiled obligations and report eligible or blocked transitions with exact scope.
Replay decisions without reissuing effects; restart at consequential stages reconstructs the accepted state.
Handle concurrency, idempotency, duplicate observations, divergence, stale plans and bounded retries.
Keep persistence/transport replaceable behind a tested contract; an initial SQLite implementation has explicit host and power-loss assumptions.
Define typed evidence for models, observations, coverage, policy assessments, approvals, effects and replay.
Qualify coverage, compatibility, temporal-safety, authority, cutover, retirement and replay courts with declared assumptions and limits.
Distinguish asserted, computed, replayed, witnessed and recognized evidence; no status promotion by declaration.
Reject fabricated PASS results, missing provenance, stale evidence and expired or out-of-scope approvals.
Bind exact models, plans, evidence, evaluator identities and receipts; CMBA/DKN integration is explicit and uses qualified pinned versions.
Court success is scoped admissibility evidence, not self-authorizing operational permission or universal truth.
Effects follow prepare-authorize-commit-observe through restricted adapters; simulations/read-only modes do not acquire production rights.
Bind migration, plan, target, cohort, pre/post-state, policy/evidence, idempotency key, principal, expiry, retries and recovery requirements.
Validate the relevant preconditions again at the point of effect; advertise any lack of atomic precondition enforcement.
Handle lost acknowledgments and partial/uncertain effects by reconciliation before retry, not presumed failure.
Consume approvals at most as specified and refuse target substitution, scope widening and replay.
Compensation and rollback preserve security floors; unknown irreversible outcomes require explicit recovery disposition.
Adapter capabilities, idempotency, effects, preconditions, time/resource limits and compensation boundaries are inspectable.

semantics.approval: Every configured model jurisdiction needs unique nonrevoked admitted keys at threshold. Exact request/evidence/plan/policy/targets/cohort and interval. Observers cannot self-register.
semantics.completion: 31 T3 cases interpreted in this signed-fixture/SQLite-simulation boundary only. Full product and external gates separate.
semantics.controller: SQLite durable hash-linked events, replayed projection, explicit plan submission/revision/pause/resume. All state-changing calls serialized; optimistic journal-head check where selected; records retained.
semantics.court: Recompute domain records, retirement records, foundation expressions and joint authorities. Malformed evidence refuses; wrong-scope/unrecognized/stale statements are ineligible. Fresh applicable contradictions block. No submitted PASS report is evidence.
semantics.coverage: Every modeled participant must occur in a current recognized complete coverage observation with admitted method. Does not prove unmodeled-source absence.
semantics.effects: Only explicit local SQLite simulated adapter. Durable intent before dispatch, exact target version CAS and security-floor check, idempotency ledger atomic with mutations. Uncertain results retain reservation; reconcile ledger before any retry; finite retry budget. Replay never calls adapter.
semantics.evidence: P-256/SHA256 signatures over exact domain-separated canonical bodies; configured pinned keys and methods scoped by claim,subject,cohort. Signature is attribution, not truth.
semantics.freshness: Reader-supplied now and nonnegative uncertainty define [now-u,now+u]. Whole interval inside half-open validity; age inclusive. No wall-clock reads in courts.
semantics.host: Caller-selected trusted local host and filesystem. Key custody, clock, actual discovery completeness, physical durability, global revocation, native P/PPI remain external.
semantics.interpretation: Opt-in operational layer; T1/T2 supplied-model semantics unchanged.
semantics.recovery: Targeted inverse transition requires new scoped request and approval; preserve monotone security floors and revoked-set union; no automatic historical approval revival. Partial/unknown effect requires explicit disposition, not false no-effect.
